segments.name: Health Sciences
segments.description: Provides technology and business services to healthcare and life sciences companies.
segments.evidence: Reportable Business Segments In 2025, we went to market across four industry-based operating segments, which are our four reportable business segments: (i) Health Sciences (HS) (ii) Financial Services (FS) (iii) Products and Resources (P&R) and (iv) Communications, Media and Technology (CMT).

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Serves banks, insurers, capital markets and payments companies with technology services.
segments.evidence: Our FS segment includes banking, capital markets, payments and insurance companies.

segments.name: Products and Resources
segments.description: Serves manufacturers, retailers, energy and logistics companies.
segments.evidence: Our P&R segment includes manufacturers, automakers, retailers, consumer goods companies, aerospace and defense companies, and travel and hospitality companies, as well as businesses providing logistics, energy and utility services.

segments.name: Communications, Media and Technology
segments.description: Serves communications, media, education and technology companies.
segments.evidence: Our CMT segment includes global communications, media and entertainment, education, publishing, information and professional services and technology companies.

revenueModel.text: Large companies pay for technology consulting, platforms and managed services.
revenueModel.evidence: As an AI builder, we provide deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, combining our perspective with extensive knowledge of our clients' organizations to build industry-specific platforms and incorporate context into systems, AI models and custom solutions.
